wifi.failedBadPassword: Couldn't connect to {ssid} - the password was not accepted
wifi.failedNotFound: Couldn't connect to {ssid} - the network did not answer
wifi.failedName: That network name cannot be used
wifi.countryHint: Regulatory region, applies at the next restart.
wifi.radioOnHint: On ethernet the wifi only disturbs Bluetooth
wifi.radioNeedsEthernet: Needs a wired connection, or the box would leave the network
wifi.forgetHint: The box stops joining it on its own

display.title: Display
display.autoHint: Automatic: the UI runs at up to 1080p, video switches the output to match. Press OK to re-detect.
display.redetectHint: Ask the TV again, for when something moved the output elsewhere

typing.title: Type here
typing.phoneHint: Press Phone to type on your phone instead.
typing.qrAlt: QR code for typing from a phone
typing.secretHint: Password field: the text goes to the TV over your local network, unencrypted.

power.title: Power
power.sleepHint: Display off - turn the TV on to wake
power.shutdownHint: Needs power cycling to turn back on
power.sleepTimerHint: Turns the TV off after the set time (the box stays on).

ambient.photosHint: Scan the QR with your phone and pick photos - they upload resized.
ambient.sleepHint: On the screensaver, over HDMI-CEC. The box stays on.
ambient.bingHint: Mix Bing's daily wallpapers into the slideshow

bt.title: Bluetooth
bt.none: No devices - scan to find some
bt.pairQuietHint: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth share one antenna on this box, and pairing is what loses. The box leaves the network for up to a minute, then rejoins it on its own.
bt.lowBatteryMsg: {name}: {pct}%. Charge it or replace the batteries soon.
bt.ertmHint: Turn this on only if a controller's buttons stick or register twice. Some controllers - Xbox ones especially - handle Bluetooth ERTM retransmission badly and behave better without it. It applies to EVERY Bluetooth device though, and removes L2CAP's own error recovery, which can upset audio devices. Takes effect after a restart.

remote.title: Remote buttons
remote.hint: Standard remotes (arrows / OK / Back / Home) work as-is. To teach a remote another button, pick an action under it and press that button on the remote. Each remote is remapped on its own.
remote.none: No remotes connected - pair or wake one first.
remote.powerWarn: The box has to be turned back on by hand after this.

power.tv_and_box: Turn off the TV and this box

remote.testHint: Press buttons on this remote - each one shows up here with the key it sends. Exits by itself after 12 seconds without a press.
remote.reassignBody: That button is already assigned to “{from}”. Reassign it to “{to}”?
remote.learnBody: Point the {remote} at the box and press the button you want to use for this.
remote.learnWarn: Every press on this remote gets recorded, even an arrow. Cancel with a different remote (e.g. the TV's own), or it times out after about 10s.
remote.panicHint: Emergency fallback: if the remote becomes unusable because of its mapping, press the same remapped button 8 times fast and the box resets that remote's buttons.

appsettings.hint: Reorder or hide apps on the home screen.
appsettings.pairingHint: Scan the code with your phone, then use the page it opens.
appsettings.pairingQrAlt: QR code to scan with your phone
appsettings.phoneActionsHint: These open a code on the TV that you scan with your phone. Some things are simply easier there than with a remote.

audio.title: Audio
audio.trackLangHint: Streams pick this audio track when available (mpv).
audio.subLangHint: Subtitles turn on when a matching track exists (mpv).
audio.tracksHint: Which audio and subtitle track a film should prefer

app.shellUnreachableHint: The tvbox service didn't answer. It may still be starting - try again in a moment.

store.title: App Store
store.hint: Community apps from the tvbox store. Installing adds the app to your home screen.
store.empty: No apps in the store yet
store.installed: {name} installed - it's on your home screen
store.busy: The box is busy with something else. Try again in a moment.

storeSources.title: Store sources
storeSources.hint: Which registries the store is built from
storeSources.saveFailed: The box could not save that
storeSources.badUrl: The box refused that address. Use https, or plain http only on your own network.
storeSources.removeHint: Apps already installed from it stay on the box
storeSources.name: Name
storeSources.autoHint: Let the box install this registry's updates overnight, without asking
storeSources.editHint: A registry publishes an index.json; that is the address to give here
storeSources.risk: Apps from an added registry are not reviewed by us. They can run code on the box, install their own programs and start other apps, exactly like the official ones can. Add a source only if you trust whoever runs it.
storeSources.devHint: Writing apps? Serve your own index.json on this network and add it here to try it out before publishing.

update.title: Software update
update.needsReprovision: Version {version} needs the box to be set up again - re-flash it, or deploy from a computer
update.installHint: The box restarts at the end (a minute or two).
update.failedRollback: Update {version} didn't start up and was rolled back automatically. Try again, or wait for the next release.
update.autoHint: Installs overnight, only while nothing is playing.
update.osAuto: Security updates install themselves in the background - no action needed.
update.rebootNeeded: A restart is recommended to finish system updates.
update.appsAutoHint: Installs app updates from the store overnight, only while the box is idle.

hostname.title: Device name
hostname.hint: Name this box so several boxes are easy to tell apart on your network.
hostname.later: Saved - the new name applies after the next box update.

region.title: Setup
region.welcome: Welcome - let's get your box ready.
region.keymapLater: Saved - the keyboard layout applies after the next box update.
region.tzLater: Saved - the time zone applies after the next box update.

backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.hint: Save the box's settings (channels, accounts, app layout) to your phone as a password-encrypted file - and restore them from there, even onto a re-flashed box.
backup.phoneHint: Scan the QR with your phone. On the page you can download an encrypted backup, or pick a saved file to restore.

restore.doneWithErrors: {n} of {total} apps restored - {failed} could not be downloaded

parental.title: Parental controls
parental.hint: One PIN for the whole box: apps use it to lock content (e.g. Live TV categories).
parental.requireHint: Installing and uninstalling apps, and the developer tools, ask for the PIN. Turning this off asks for it too.

mqtt.title: MQTT / Home Assistant
mqtt.hint: Bridge this box to Home Assistant or any MQTT broker: a now-playing sensor, remote commands and on-screen notifications. Changes apply immediately.
mqtt.offHint: Leave the broker host empty to turn the integration off.
mqtt.deviceIdHint: The topic segment this box publishes under. Two boxes must never share one.

ir.title: IR blaster (TV volume)
ir.hint: Send volume and mute to the TV through a network IR blaster when the TV takes no CEC volume. The remotes' volume buttons and MQTT/voice commands all use it.
ir.offHint: Leave the device host / URL empty to turn the integration off.
ir.actionsHintEsphome: The learned signal slot to replay per command - the options of the device's signal select.
ir.actionsHintHa: The Home Assistant script to run per command (a script.* entity id).

firetvir.title: Fire TV remote → TV IR
firetvir.hint: Teach a paired Fire TV / Alexa remote to control the TV's volume, mute and power over its own infrared - no Fire TV box needed. Great if the remote's power/volume stopped working after a reset.
firetvir.depsNeeded: This needs a one-time Bluetooth support download (internet required).
firetvir.noRemote: No Bluetooth remote paired. Pair one in Bluetooth above first.
firetvir.narrow: Keep typing to narrow the list…
firetvir.testHint: Point the remote at the TV and try each button - it should react. Nothing is saved to the remote yet.
firetvir.someUnsupported: Some buttons use an IR format this box can't generate yet - they're greyed out. Try another codeset for your brand.
firetvir.programmed: Done - the remote now controls the TV directly. Its volume keys were handed back to it.
firetvir.credit: TV codes from the community irdb database (github.com/probonopd/irdb). See About for credits.
firetvir.suggested: Detected your TV as {brand} - suggested below.
firetvir.perKeyHint: Each button can use a different brand - e.g. a soundbar on volume. A second device makes one press blast both (the TV's own power still goes over HDMI-CEC).

fileserver.title: File server
fileserver.hint: The box's folders over the network, so you can copy to it from a computer: screensaver images, games, or a console BIOS into the folder the emulator reads. It will not start without a password.
fileserver.urlHint: Type this into your computer's file manager. Username: {user}
fileserver.foldersHint: The box finds what can be shared itself, so a new folder shows up here on its own.
fileserver.warnTvbox: holds the box's settings and the apps' logins

err.password_required: Set a password first - it will not start without one.
err.share_failed: Could not prepare the share (write error).

appshares.title: App sharing
appshares.offeringHint: Folders an installed app may let another tvbox on your network read. Each app says in advance which of its own folders those are - nothing else can be offered - and reading is all the other box can do.
appshares.noRclone: Needs rclone, which the file server can install.
appshares.offerHint: Shows a code for five minutes. Type it on the other box.
appshares.boxesHint: A box appears here once it has been let in. Each holds a key of its own, so forgetting one takes that key back and leaves the others working.
appshares.scanHint: Finds a box that is showing a code right now.
appshares.noneFound: No box is showing a code. Start on the other box first.
appshares.enterCode: The code from the other box
appshares.paired: Connected to {name}. Both boxes can read what the other offers.
appshares.inApp: Bringing files across is done in the app itself.

err.not_a_box: That is not a tvbox, or it is not offering anything.
err.nothing_shared: Nothing is switched on to offer.

appshares.pairedOneWay: Connected to {name}, one way: this box can read from it, but it offers nothing back yet. Switch a folder on over there and connect again.

network.wifiHint: The network this box is on
network.fileserverHint: Reach the box's folders from a computer
network.mqttHint: Now-playing, commands and notifications over MQTT
network.sharesHint: A NAS as a source, so films can live on the network
network.mirroringHint: Show a phone's screen on the TV
network.appsharesHint: Which of an app's folders another tvbox on your network may read, and which boxes have been let in.

mirroring.title: Screen mirroring
mirroring.startHint: Then pick this box on your phone
mirroring.note: Shows a phone's screen on the TV. The phone connects to the box directly over wifi, not through the router, so the box's radio becomes a receiver for as long as you use it.
mirroring.armedNote: Open the cast or Smart View menu on your phone and pick this box. No PIN needed. If nobody connects within two minutes the box stops on its own.

err.radio-busy: The wifi radio is busy. Try again in a moment.
err.no-wifi: This box has no wifi adapter.
err.no-wfd: This box's wifi software has no Wi-Fi Display support.
err.group: Couldn't set the wifi radio up as a receiver.
err.dhcp: Couldn't hand the phone an address.

mirroring.offlineWarning: This box is on wifi, so it goes offline while mirroring. It reconnects to the same network when you stop.
mirroring.offlineNow: The box is offline while mirroring, and comes back when you stop.

peripherals.remoteHint: Teach a remote one of its other buttons
peripherals.irHint: TV volume for a TV that takes none over CEC
peripherals.phoneRemoteHint: Press the buttons from your phone

apps.orderHint: Which apps show and in what order

system.backupHint: Copy the settings to your phone, or put them back

shares.title: Network shares
shares.hint: Play films and music from a NAS. The Files app lists each share as a source.
shares.editHint: The box reads the share; nothing on it is changed.
shares.addPhoneHint: Scan a QR and type the address and password on your phone.
shares.phoneTitle: Add a share from your phone
shares.phoneHint: Scan the code, then enter the server's address on your phone. It will list what the server offers, so there is nothing to type twice.
shares.whatHint: Test asks the server what it offers, then fills these in for you.
shares.name: Name on the TV
shares.nameHint: Also the folder it appears as. Letters, numbers and dashes.
shares.pickFolderHint: Or leave the folder empty to mount the whole share.
shares.needRclone: The box needs a small network tool for this. Installing it takes a moment.
shares.playHint: A connected share shows up in the Files app, next to the box's own folders.

err.bad_share: That share name is not valid.
err.bad_name: That name is not valid: use letters, numbers and dashes.
err.bad_user: That user name is too long.
err.name_taken: There is already a share with that name.
err.too_many: There is no room for another share.
err.rclone_missing: The network tool is missing - install it first.

shares.cacheMediaHint: Films and music: they start straight away and play as they arrive.
shares.cacheGamesHint: Games: the box copies a game to itself the first time you open it, then plays it from there. The first start is slower; after that it does not stutter.

phoneRemote.enableHint: Let a paired phone press this box's buttons over your local network
phoneRemote.note: While this is off the box accepts nothing from the network. Turned on, a paired phone can press the same buttons the remote does.
phoneRemote.onNote: The box is listening on your local network. Only a paired phone can press anything, and you can remove any of them here. Turning this off removes the pairings too.
phoneRemote.pairFailed: Turn the phone remote on first.
phoneRemote.pairHint: Scan this with your phone and enter the four digits below. You need to be on the same wifi.
phoneRemote.pairRowHint: Shows a code on the TV for your phone to scan
phoneRemote.addressRowHint: A QR code, for reopening it on a phone that is already paired
phoneRemote.addressHint: The same address for every paired phone. One that is already paired needs no code again; a new one does, and the Pair row gives it.
phoneRemote.title: Phone as a remote
phoneRemote.unreachable: The box did not answer. Try again.
phoneRemote.unsupported: This box's software is too old for it.

dev.debugNote: This boot only: the box closes it again on the next restart. It listens on the box itself, so reaching it from elsewhere needs an SSH tunnel: ssh -L {port}:127.0.0.1:{port} <box>, then chrome://inspect.
dev.debugPortHint: The box restarts and accepts Chromium DevTools on port {port}
dev.screenHint: Your paired phone can see what is on the TV
dev.screenNote: A still picture every few seconds, not a live view - it is for testing. A separate switch from the remote, because a picture shows everything that is on screen.
dev.screenOnNote: Your paired phone can see the TV right now, including anything you type. It stops on its own, and you can stop it any time.
dev.screenUnsupported: This box's software is too old for it.
dev.title: Developer tools
